entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Grand Arbiter of the Azorius, a conduit of justice who dispenses it without ego or remorse.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon lord of the Cult of Rakdos, whose very shadow takes cruel life.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Simic guildmaster and author of Biomancy, who funds Project Kraj.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros archangel of war demanding total commitment.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Dimir figure favoring dissolving victims entirely.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Golgari queen who sees the dead move to the rhythm of necromancy.

entities.name: Bougrat
aliases: Bougrat, druid of the Cult of Yore
entities.description: Druid of the Cult of Yore.

entities.name: Belko
aliases: Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

entities.name: Ukl
entities.description: A Gruul raider whose last words concern a bronze bombshell.

entities.name: Lyzolda
entities.description: A blood witch with man-eating pet rats and an audience of cultists.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Guild of experiments led by Momir Vig.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild of law led by Augustin IV.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: Pact signed by the Ten at Pillar of the Paruns.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Simic experiment designed to choose its own evolution.

entities.name: Pillar of the Paruns
entities.description: Tower built where the Ten signed the Guildpact.

entities.name: Ghost Quarter
entities.description: Place where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

events.summary: Augustin IV speaks of peace gentle yet unstoppable.
events.quote: As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable.

events.summary: Augustin IV promises quiet in his presence.
events.quote: This world may not know peace, but in my presence you *will* know quiet.

events.summary: Alovnek demands justice now rather than waiting for the arbiters.
Guilds exterminate those who know too much; some vindictive ghosts turn their knowledge against the guilded.
events.quote: Guilds often exterminate those who saw or knew too much.

events.summary: Savra declares the dead move to necromancy's hollow rhythm.
events.quote: All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy.

events.summary: Gorev Hadszak finds a victim bearing marks of an executed killer.
events.quote: but he was executed years ago!

events.summary: Rakdos relishes entertainment with his dinner.
events.quote: I like a little entertainment with my dinner.

events.summary: Rakdos calls on his servants to rage, renewing ancient power in blood.
events.quote: Rage, my servants. Our ancient power is renewed in blood.

events.summary: Ghut Rak finds a good use for an Azorius courthouse.
events.quote: Finally, a good use for an Azorius courthouse.

events.summary: Bonmod asks a runner to report that a delivery has been held up.
events.quote: Send a runner to Tin Street, and tell 'em the delivery has been . . . uh . . . held up.

events.summary: Momir Vig proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund Project Kraj.
events.quote: We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj.

events.summary: Momir Vig says Experiment Kraj was designed to choose its own evolution.
events.quote: it was designed to choose its own evolution.

events.summary: Belko warns of the Demon's work in a rain of gore.
events.quote: This is the Demon's work, and only ill can come of it.

events.summary: Rakdos adds the touch of having spikes rip through the skin from beneath.
events.quote: Having the spikes rip through the skin from beneath was a touch added by Rakdos himself.

events.summary: Ukl is killed after wanting to take a bronze bombshell with them.
events.quote: Ooh, shiny! Let's pull off the chain and take her with us.

events.summary: Leaders of the ten guilds use go-betweens rather than meeting face to face.
events.quote: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

events.summary: The Ten signed the Guildpact where the Pillar of the Paruns now stands.
events.quote: Built on the very ground where the Ten signed the Guildpact

relations.quote: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice
We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form

relations.note: his shadow and touch shape Rakdos power
relations.quote: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.
